Salesforce: Remove Sprinto Access
Remove the access Sprinto was given in Salesforce. Covers every way Sprinto can be connected to Salesforce and the steps to take in Salesforce for each.
Use this guide to remove the access you gave Sprinto in Salesforce. These steps are done in Salesforce, not in Sprinto. To connect Salesforce to Sprinto again later, see Salesforce Integration.
Which connection method did you use?
Sprinto can be connected to Salesforce in 2 ways. Find the method you used, then follow the steps in that section.
Connection method
How to tell
Access review connection (Salesforce sign-in window)
You entered your Salesforce subdomain, signed in and allowed access for access reviews.
Trust Center CRM connection (Sprinto Salesforce app)
You clicked Connect Salesforce for Trust Center (scopes Api and Offline Access), not for access reviews.
Access review connection (Salesforce sign-in window)
Who must do this: Salesforce administrator (for all users); any user can revoke their own access
What gets removed: All OAuth tokens for the app Sprinto used are revoked and, if it was installed, the app is uninstalled.
Steps
In Salesforce, open Setup, enter Connected Apps OAuth Usage in the Quick Find box and select Connected Apps OAuth Usage.
Find the app Sprinto used. The app may be listed as Sprinto or Truto. Click the number in its User Count column.
On the Connected App User's Usage page, click Revoke All. This removes access for every user, including someone who has left.
Back on Connected Apps OAuth Usage, if the app's Action column shows Uninstall and it was installed only for Sprinto, click Uninstall.
If the Action column shows Unblock, click Unblock — otherwise reconnecting will fail.
If the app isn't listed, search Quick Find for External Client Apps OAuth Usage and revoke all of the app's tokens there.
No admin access? Open your personal settings → Advanced User Details → OAuth Connected Apps and click Revoke next to the app.
Confirm it's removed
The app no longer appears on Connected Apps OAuth Usage (or shows a User Count of 0) and isn't listed under OAuth Connected Apps in the connecting user's Advanced User Details.
If you uninstall the app, whoever reconnects needs the Approve Uninstalled Connected Apps permission, or an admin must install the app again.
Official guide: Salesforce Help
Trust Center CRM connection (Sprinto Salesforce app)
Who must do this: Salesforce administrator (for all users); any user can revoke their own access
What gets removed: All OAuth tokens for Sprinto's Salesforce app are revoked and, if it was installed, the app is uninstalled.
Steps
In Salesforce, open Setup, enter Connected Apps OAuth Usage in the Quick Find box and select Connected Apps OAuth Usage.
Find the app Sprinto used. The app may be listed as Sprinto. Click the number in its User Count column.
On the Connected App User's Usage page, click Revoke All. This removes access for every user, including someone who has left.
Back on Connected Apps OAuth Usage, if the app's Action column shows Uninstall and it was installed only for Sprinto, click Uninstall.
If the Action column shows Unblock, click Unblock — otherwise reconnecting will fail.
If the app isn't listed, search Quick Find for External Client Apps OAuth Usage and revoke all of the app's tokens there.
No admin access? Open your personal settings → Advanced User Details → OAuth Connected Apps and click Revoke next to the app.
Confirm it's removed
Sprinto's app no longer appears on Connected Apps OAuth Usage (or shows a User Count of 0) and isn't listed under OAuth Connected Apps in the connecting user's Advanced User Details.
If you uninstall the app, whoever reconnects needs the Approve Uninstalled Connected Apps permission, or an admin must install the app again.
Official guide: Salesforce Help
